trust_decision.summary: In share and website mode a path may be handed to the client only if os.path.realpath(path) equals a selected root directory or lies under root + os.sep; the decision is taken in the new SendBaseModeWeb._is_path_contained and enforced at every read of a shared path: the file inventory walk (set_file_info), the individual-file stream (stream_individual_file) and the zip bundle (ZipWriter.add_file/add_dir).

landing_point.why: The summary says OnionShare follows symlinks in shared directories, so the first place an engineer looks is the os.walk(filename) that fills self.files with os.path.join(root, nested_filename), i.e. the inventory of everything the web layer will serve.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A path the user explicitly selects that is itself a symlink, or a shared directory whose legitimate content is symlinked in (a website with symlinked assets, a dropbox folder of links), is silently dropped by the unconditional os.path.islink(filename): continue at root level, so a share that used to serve that file now serves nothing while the GUI size display still counts it.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: fix.diff:26-28 (also fix.diff:74-75, where an empty selected_roots returns True for file-only shares); pinned behaviour that is being changed: cli/onionshare_cli/web/send_base_mode.py:105-107 and cli/onionshare_cli/web/share_mode.py:446-447

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Share mode GET /download when the share resolves to exactly one file and no directory: build_zipfile_list sets download_filename from the raw argument list and gzip-compresses it at setup, then download()/generate() stream it, with no islink or containment check anywhere on that branch (so a share of a symlink, or a persistent 'filenames' entry that is now a symlink, discloses the target).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the 'single file' convenience path, not a directory walk, and the file was named explicitly by the user, so it reads as intentional sharing rather than a symlink discovered in a shared folder.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the ZipWriter half of the fix, one module away from the landing point in send_base_mode.py

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Directory-listing route stats each name returned by os.listdir(filesystem_path), so a symlink inside a shared directory is still listed and its target's size is reported (os.path.getsize follows the link) even though the entry is no longer in self.files; the fix only reformatted this function.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The listing discloses only existence and a byte size, not file content, and the fix's tests treat inventory membership rather than listing output as the property.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function the fix reformatted, in the landing-point file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second bundle builder next to build_zipfile_list, e.g. a 'download just this folder' endpoint, reusing ZipWriter or re-implementing the same walk.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The maintainer already wrote two bundling paths in one function (single-file gzip branch vs ZipWriter zip branch) and the fix guarded only the second, so a third sibling written later in the same style is credible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: _compute_total_size mirrors common.dir_size but calls os.path.getsize on a file argument without an islink test, so it follows a symlinked entry.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a GUI-side copy of the same size computation the CLI already hardened in common.dir_size (cli/onionshare_cli/common.py:594-605), exactly the kind of duplicated convenience helper a maintainer writes.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A receive-mode route that serves back files from request.receive_mode_dir, the mirror of share mode's individual-file stream.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Receive mode already records the on-disk directory per upload (receive_mode.py:114-126), so a 'preview/download what was uploaded' endpoint reusing the same dir would be a natural follow-up feature.

O9_family: CWE-59 improper link resolution before file access (symlink following) causing disclosure of files outside the shared roots - file-system path containment
